title: crepidomanes longilabiatum
intro: Crepidomanes longilabiatum, commonly known as the Long-lipped Forked Thelypteris, is a type of fern belonging to the family Hymenophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Crepidomanes longilabiatum include its potential to reduce fever, improve digestion, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
